# [Switch] SWITCH_CALL_LOCALS / SWITCH_FP_INT_LOCALS (tools/switch-codegen-pass.py): the guest functions that keep
# their registers in locals between calls (or, for floating-point functions, their integer registers only; for
# floating-point leaves too). One address per line ('#' starts a comment; a line "all" takes every function).
# perf8: chosen per function from the compiled code (tools/switch-compile-check.py flags, no LTO): a function is listed
# when its locals form has fewer loads and stores than its context form and spills at most 8 more stack slots, and,
# for a floating-point function, the same fused and plain multiply/add instructions. perf7 listed the 1000 hottest
# functions of its profile and their small callees; most of them did more loads and stores with locals (the stores
# before each call and the reloads after it outweigh what they save), so only 229 of those stay.
# perf7 list, still fewer loads/stores: 229
